verdicts.reason: A reads cleanly left to right: logo, jar, a large 'Glow.' and the CTA, all vertically centred and evenly spaced. Its flaws are a jar too small for its 'SOLSTICE' label to be legible and a CTA with no button treatment. B pushes the logo up against the top edge so it is off the shared centre line, shrinks 'Glow.' so it is weaker, and leaves a large dead gap between the jar and the headline, so the spacing looks arbitrary. B's jar is also tiny, with an unreadable label.
